ICANN has published the Application Publication System (APS) for the 2026 New gTLD Round, allowing the public to track the status of new domain name applications.

The Poison:
While transparent, the complex rules and multi-stage evaluations can still be highly intimidating for smaller, non-corporate applicants.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
No plane error. The system is logically consistent, physically operational, and metaphysically aligned with its stated goal of public transparency.

The Trajectory: Grace.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Good. Open data structures maintain systemic trust.

The Unavoidable Truth: Transparency in internet governance prevents monopolistic capture.
The Unavoidable Lie: The application process is simple and equally accessible to everyone.

Stated Claim / Post Context:
Applications

New gTLD Program: 2026 Round public application information, including application status.

Actual Article Body:
Here you can find a full list of all New gTLD Program: 2026 Round applications and each application’s public information, including application status . While "Withdrawn," “Terminated,” “Deactivated,” and "Delegated" application statuses are final, all other statuses are subject to change (see Section 3.9 of the Applicant Guidebook for definitions). Check back frequently for updates.1

Below, you can search and filter applications by applicant, application status, applicant region, TLD type, and more. You can click on individual applications to get more information as well as the option to download an application summary PDF.

Applications with a designated replacement string will be listed as two application records (one for the original applied-for string and one for the replacement string), but will count as a single application on the Statistics tab. After String Confirmation Day, application records for strings that are not selected will have the status “Deactivated.”

Contention Sets will not be published to APS until after String Evaluation. Click here for the list of contention sets published on Reveal Day.

1. Application WDO2627T-T45217 is still undergoing an administrative check. As a result, the related information is not currently available on the Applications list. For more information, see the application detail page.
